description: Writes up to three reply drafts (short, warm, formal; at most 120 words each) that a business owner can post under a customer review on Google, Yelp, Tripadvisor, Naver or elsewhere. Gemini writes them from the review and the owner's details only, without web search; then OOO Works' checks drop any draft that offers or promises something the owner didn't (refunds, discounts, free items, guarantees), asks for the review to be changed or removed, adds a number, name, link or phone number that isn't in the review or the owner's details, makes a superlative or health claim, or, for a health business, mentions any health detail. Warnings say what to watch before posting. Drafts are suggestions for the owner to read and edit; nothing is posted. Limited to 10 replies a day per caller; identical requests are answered from memory for 24 hours.

business_type.description: what the business does, e.g. dentist or Italian restaurant

contact.description: phone, email or page where the reviewer can reach the business privately

language.description: reply language: auto (the review's language), en, ko, ja, zh, es, fr, de, it, pt, nl, vi, th or id

platform.description: where it was posted: google, yelp, tripadvisor, naver, kakao, facebook, trustpilot, booking, airbnb or other

review.description: the customer's review as posted, at most 2,000 characters

reviewer.description: the reviewer's name as the platform shows it, to greet them by

stars.description: the review's star rating, 1 to 5; leave out when there is none

what_to_say.description: anything the owner wants the reply to say, in their words

name: write_review_reply
title: Write replies to a customer review
